facts.text: The hotel is at Yunda Central Plaza, No. 289, Shawan Road, in Changsha's Yuhua District.
facts.excerpt: Yunda Central Plaza, No. 289, Shawan Road, Yuhua District, Changsha, Hunan, China, 410000

facts.text: Changsha Huanghua International Airport is about 18 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: CSX is located approximately 18.0 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle, but offers a Rolls-Royce limousine service for a fee.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: A Rolls-Royce limousine airport transfer is available on request for a fee.
facts.excerpt: Rolls-Royce Limousine Service; fee: 1600.00 CNY (one way) ;on request

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have sweeping city views.
facts.excerpt: exquisitely styled guest rooms and suites, boasting sweeping views of the city

facts.text: The rooms are designed and decorated with subtle Chinese touches.
facts.excerpt: The rooms are beautifully designed and decorated with subtle Chinese touches.

facts.text: Rooms have an iPad remote control and a surround sound system.
facts.excerpt: Well-equipped amenities, including an iPad remote control and a surround sound system

facts.text: St. Regis Butler Service is available any time, day or night.
facts.excerpt: Every experience is enhanced with St. Regis Butler Service available any time day or night.

facts.text: The hotel has a top-level swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: Rejuvenate in The St. Regis Athletic Club or the top level swimming pool.

facts.text: The indoor pool is an infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Infinity Pool

facts.text: The St. Regis Athletic Club fitness center has city views and is open 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Athletic Club offers exclusive fitness with stunning city views and luxury amenities.

facts.text: The fitness center has sauna and steam rooms.
facts.excerpt:
Sauna rooms

Steam Rooms

facts.text: Yan Ting serves Cantonese cuisine with a modern presentation alongside authentic Hunan dishes.
facts.excerpt: Yan Ting showcases luxury Cantonese cuisine with a modern presentation, accompanied by authentic Hunan dishes

facts.text: Un is a Japanese restaurant with five private rooms, three of which can accommodate live cooking.
facts.excerpt: Un's five private rooms—three of which can accommodate live cooking—are sophisticated yet relaxing environments.

facts.text: Un's menu features fresh sushi and sashimi.
facts.excerpt: The authentic flavors of Japanese gastronomy are showcased in an extensive menu of fresh sushi and sashimi.

facts.text: Social has an open kitchen combining buffet and live cooking.
facts.excerpt: Inviting open kitchen with an interactive combination of buffet and live cooking

facts.text: The St. Regis Afternoon Tea in the lobby-level Drawing Room has a local twist.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Afternoon Tea celebrates traditions from the 1800s yet incorporates a modern interpretation with a local twist.

facts.text: The Tea Lounge serves premium Chinese teas and light meals following Chinese tea traditions.
facts.excerpt: The Tea Lounge offers a complete service with time-honored Chinese traditions, showcasing a wide variety of premium Chinese teas and light meals.

facts.text: The St. Regis Bar pays homage to the King Cole Bar in New York and serves The St. Regis Bloody Mary.
facts.excerpt: Paying homage to the world-renowned King Cole Bar in New York City, The St. Regis Bar features premium wines, rare spirits, and handcrafted cocktails, including The St. Regis Bloody Mary.

facts.text: At The St. Regis Bar, Champagne bottles are opened by sabering.
facts.excerpt: Bottles of Champagne are opened with flair by sabering.

facts.text: The hotel has a Grand Ballroom of about 2,000 square meters.
facts.excerpt: Spanning 2000 sqm Grand Ballroom

facts.text: On-site self parking is complimentary for guests.
facts.excerpt: Self parking is complimentary for guests.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Changsha.

facts.text: The nearest subway station is Changsha Avenue on Line 2.
facts.excerpt: Changsha Avenue, Line 2
